title: Prestige International School ERP - RFID Schema Reference
description: Defines the Firestore collection schemas and constraints for RFID smartcards and automated scan attendance records.

uid.description: Normalized lowercase hexadecimal UID reported by the physical RFID reader (e.g., '3a363a16'). Primary key.

studentId.description: Firestore document ID of the student from /students/{studentId}.

studentName.description: Denormalized student full name for fast UI lookups.

sectionId.description: Firestore document ID of the section from /sections/{sectionId}.

assignedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the card was paired to the student.

studentId.description: Firestore document ID of the student.

studentUid.description: Permanent student UID or admission code for parent/student identification.

sectionId.description: Section ID of the student at the time of scan.

outTime.description: Time of exit scan if recorded on afternoon departure.

source.description: Tag identifying that this attendance event was captured by an RFID edge reader.

deviceId.description: Identifier of the IoT scanner or gateway device.

uid.description: Physical RFID card UID used during the scan.

tapCount.description: Number of times the card was tapped during the calendar day.
